risks.proof: A video clip of the motor running and the machine stitching at full speed.

risks.risk: Poor stitch quality or timing issues
risks.proof: A clear photo of a stitch sample produced by the machine on two layers of fabric.
risks.if_unproven: As requiring professional timing adjustment and servicing.

risks.risk: Oil pump failure or contaminated reservoir
risks.proof: A photo of the oil pan under the machine head showing the oil level and clarity.
risks.if_unproven: As requiring a full internal cleaning and pump repair.

Photo of the underside of the machine head (oil reservoir).
Close-up photo of a stitch sample (front and back).
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the brand and model from the manufacturer's plates. It will be priced at its worst-case functional state until operational proof is provided.
